type: ({ agentPresentation, title, status, rows, reason, sources, basedOn, updated, actions, onRefresh, headingLevel, labels, announcement, appearance, }: ChangeSummaryProps) => JSX.Element
description:
What changed (spec section 12.8): what moved, why, and what to do next. The
host supplies the status, the rows and their tones; each row says which way
with an arrow and a hidden word, and what it means with color, so more late
invoices is red though it rises. Its polite region says each status change
once unless the host owns announcements.

parameters.name:
{
  agentPresentation,
  title,
  status,
  rows,
  reason,
  sources,
  basedOn,
  updated,
  actions,
  onRefresh,
  headingLevel = 3,
  labels,
  announcement = "polite",
  appearance = "card",
}

actions.type: readonly { id: string; label: string; primary?: boolean; onSelect(): void; }[] | undefined
actions.description: Shown while ready: one primary next step, one secondary.

agentPresentation.description: Optional avatar, name, identity controls and tray color in the existing header.

announcement.description: Speak status changes politely, or leave announcements to the host.

appearance.description: "card" sits on a tray; "plain" lives on its host's paper.

basedOn.description: The footer's «اعتمادًا على ٣ تقارير» and «حُدّث قبل ٥ د».

reason.description: The most likely reason, with a citation for each of `sources`.

rows.type: readonly { id: string; metric: string; change: ReactNode; direction: "up" | "down" | "flat"; tone: "good" | "bad" | "neutral"; series?: readonly number[]; }[]
rows.description: The first six show. `direction` says which way, `tone` what it means.
